_README: Path configuration template for the muonDIS FASERcal charm-tagging toy.
COPY this file to json/ev.json and edit the paths for your setup:
python/config.py reads json/ev.json first, falling back to this template.
Override the whole file with the FASERCAL_SETTINGS environment variable.
Keys beginning with '_' are comments and are ignored by the loader.

_help.production_dir: Holds the POWHEG LHE samples reused from the FASERnu study: production_v1 (fitted charm), production_pc (perturbative charm).
_help.charm_npz: Per-charm-hadron cache written by fasercal_toy.py (charm sign, decay length, semileptonic-muon kinematics).
_help.report_pdf: Output PDF of the FASERcal charm/anticharm tagging toy.
